content: Musa issgeɛɛed Aqiḍun n Umsagar
Issiweř SIDI ak-d Musa, inna:
“Deg wass amezwaru n uyur amezwaru ad tessgeɛɛded Tazeddiɣt, Aqiḍun n Umsagar.
Ad dayes tegged Ttabut n Cchadet uca ad tedřed Ttabut s uřeḥḥaf.
Ad tessidfed tazewḍa uca ad tt tsettfed asettef nnes. Ad tessidfed řqendiř uca ad tessiɣed řefnarat nnes.
Ad tessarsed aɛalṭar n wureɣ i řebxur zzat i Ttabut n Cchadet uca ad tegged arwaq n wadaf zzat n Tzeddiɣt.
Ad tessarsed aɛalṭar n wecmaḍ zzat i wadaf n Tzeddiɣt, Aqiḍun n Umsagar.
Ad tessarsed tabanyut jar Uqiḍun n Umsagar d uɛalṭar uca ad dayes tegged aman.
Ad tessbedded řemraḥ ɣar marra iɣezdisen nnes uca ad tayřed arwaq n wadaf n řemraḥ.
Ad teksid zzect i wedhan uca ad tdehned Tazeddiɣt d marra min dayes iǧan. Ad tt tessqeddsed ak-d marra řeqcuɛ nnes. Ad tiři nettat d tamqeddast.
Ad tdehned aɛalṭar n wecmaḍ s marra řeqcuɛ nnes. Ad tessqeddsed aɛalṭar. Aɛalṭar ad yiři d amqeddas qaɛ.
Ad tdehned tabanyut d uḍar nnes uca ad tt tessqeddsed.
Ad dd-tessqarrbed Harun d warraw nnes ɣar wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar uca ad ten tessirded s waman.
Ad tessyarḍed i Harun arruḍ iqeddsen uca ad t tdehned uca ad t tessqeddsed, maḥend ad ayi yiři d akehhan i Necc.
Xenni ad dd-tessqarrbed iḥenjiren nnes uca ad asen tyarḍed tcamirat.
Ad ten tdehned am mammec tdehned babatsen, maḥend ad ayi sexxaren am yikehhanen. Ad yiři wedhan nsen i nitni d ict n tukehhant i řebda i marra jjiřat nsen.”
Igga Musa marra am mammec yumur SIDI, wah, ammu i t igga.
Imsar deg uyur amezwaru n useggʷas wiss tnayen, deg wass amezwaru n uyur, aqa ssgeɛɛden Tazeddiɣt.
Musa issgeɛɛed Tazeddiɣt, issars tiyarsawin nnes, igga daysent tifeřwin, igga xasent tiḥenya n uɛarreḍ tinni xasent iẓwan, uca issbedd ipilaren nnes.
Ibezzeɛ Aqiḍun x Tzeddiɣt uca issars xas taseqqaft n Uqiḍun am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Iksi Cchadet uca issars i-tt daxeř di Ttabut uca icedd iɛumad i tarebbut ɣar Ttabut uca issars taqebbart n weṣřaḥ x Ttabut.
Issidef Ttabut di Tzeddiɣt uca yuyeř ařeḥḥaf am dduri uca issduriy Ttabut n Cchadet am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Issars tazewḍa deg Uqiḍun n Umsagar, ɣar uɣezdis n ccamal n Tzeddiɣt, ɣar barra n uřeḥḥaf.
Isettef xas aɣrum zzat i wudem n SIDI, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Issars řqendiř deg Uqiḍun n Umsagar, nican deg urendad n tzewḍa, ɣar jjihet n ljanub n Tzeddiɣt.
Issars xas tiftiřin zzat i wudem n SIDI, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Iwca amcan i uɛalṭar n wureɣ deg Uqiḍun n Umsagar zzat i uřeḥḥaf.
Issbexxar xas řebxur ittfuḥen am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Yuyeř arwaq ɣar wadaf n Tzeddiɣt.
Iwca amcan i uɛalṭar n wecmaḍ ɣar wadaf n Tzeddiɣt, Aqiḍun n Umsagar. Issbexxar xas taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ d tewhibt n řɣiǧet, am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Issars tabanyut jar Uqiḍun n Umsagar d uɛalṭar. Igga dayes aman i usird.
Musa d Harun d warraw nnes ssirden zzayes ifassen d iḍaren nsen.
Řami tuɣa ttadfen ɣar Uqiḍun n Umsagar u řami dd-ttqarraben ɣar uɛalṭar, ssirden ixef nsen am mammec yumur SIDI i Musa.
Ɣar marra iɣezdisen n Tzeddiɣt d uɛalṭar ittwagg as-dd řemraḥ uca yuyeř netta arwaq n wadaf n řemraḥ. Ammu i ikemmeř Musa řxedmet.
Xenni idřa useynu Aqiḍun n Umsagar uca aɛuǧi n SIDI iccur Tazeddiɣt.
War izemmar Musa ad yadef ɣar Uqiḍun n Umsagar, minzi aseynu yarsa xas u aɛuǧi n SIDI iccur Tazeddiɣt.
Řami dd-igeɛɛed useynu zi sennej n Tzeddiɣt, fesyen ayt n Israil iqiḍan nsen uca ammu muṭṭyen zeg wemcan ɣar wemcan.
Mařa war dd-igeɛɛed useynu, war fesyen iqiḍan nsen ař ass i di tuɣa ittgeɛɛed.
Minzi aseynu n SIDI tuɣa yarsa x Tzeddiɣt s uziř uca di ǧiřet tuɣa timessi zzat i tiṭṭawin n marra taddart n Israil deg imuṭṭuyen nsen zeg wemcan ɣar wemcan.
